subject: Invite: FitterGo customer advocate for 'Customer Voice' product roundtable
messages:
From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: sara.patel@fittergo.com, devon.k@fittergo.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Invite: FitterGo customer advocate for 'Customer Voice' product roundtable

Hi Sara / Devon,

Hope you both are well. I'm reaching out to invite a FitterGo customer advocate to join a short virtual roundtable we're running on Tuesday, June 30 — "Customer Voice: Scaling LLM features into production." The format is tight: roughly 20 minutes for a customer case study + 10 minutes for live Q&A. We want to feature a real engineering/business outcome and practical takeaways (architecture choices, latency/cost tradeoffs, rollout learnings).

Why we thought of FitterGo: your team has been an early and productive user of Redwood Dedicated, and the way you balanced latency SLAs with cost controls has been a great example for other customers. The session will be recorded and used as part of a short customer highlight (video + blog excerpt) — we credit and share everything with you for approval.

If FitterGo is open, we'd love to:
- Have one speaker (engineer or PM) present a 15–20 min case study
- Do a 30-min prep call to align on slides and talking points
- Share speaker guidelines and a draft agenda (attached)

We can offer a modest honorarium or joint promotional amplification (newsletter + social) — whatever is easiest for your approvals.

Would Sara be the right person to lead this, or should we coordinate with Devon? If yes, are you available for a 30-min prep call next week (options below)?

Proposed prep windows (PDT):
- Mon 6/15 10:00–10:30
- Tue 6/16 14:00–14:30
- Wed 6/17 16:00–16:30

Attached: ProdScale_speaker_guidelines.pdf, event_agenda_v1.docx

Thanks and appreciate you considering it — excited to highlight the work FitterGo has done.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai

--
Attachment stubs: ProdScale_speaker_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 2 pages), event_agenda_v1.docx (DOCX, 1 page)

From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@fittergo.com>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: devon.k@fittergo.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:05:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: FitterGo customer advocate for 'Customer Voice' product roundtable

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 9:15 AM rafael.mendes@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hope you both are well. I'm reaching out to invite a FitterGo customer advocate to join a short virtual roundtable we're running on Tuesday, June 30 — "Customer Voice: Scaling LLM features into production."

Hi Rafael — thanks for thinking of us, we appreciate the invite. Devon and I discussed briefly and we're interested in participating. A few quick notes from our side: 

- We will need a short internal legal/comms review before anything goes public (standard for customer quotes).
- We can do a ~15 minute technical overview + 10 minute Q&A — that fits better into our product team's calendar.
- Devon would be the go-to for technical details; I can join to cover outcomes and business impact.

A 30-min prep call sounds good. Our availability next week is limited but we can do:
- Tue 6/16 14:00–14:30 PT (works for Devon)
- Thu 6/18 09:00–09:30 PT (if needed)

Could you send a short list of expected questions and any NDA/approval language your comms team requires? Also please include any recording/reuse terms so we can route it through legal.

Sara Patel
VP Product, FitterGo
sara.patel@fittergo.com

--
(Quoted original message omitted.)

From: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai
To: sara.patel@fittergo.com, devon.k@fittergo.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: FitterGo customer advocate for 'Customer Voice' product roundtable

Thanks Sara — really glad to hear you're open to it.

Agenda and approvals: Marissa (cc'd) will own speaker coordination and the short list of questions for the prep call; she'll also share our standard legal/comms blurb for reuse and recording consent. We try to keep the legal ask minimal: permission to record, publish a short excerpt, and use a single attribution line; we can route any language through your counsel prior to publication.

Prep call: Tue 6/16 14:00 PT works for us — I'll place a calendar hold and include a Zoom link.

Marissa — can you please: 1) share a one-page prep doc with the questions and slide template, 2) confirm the recording/reuse language we ask customers to sign off on, and 3) capture any brand assets we need (logo + short bio)?

Sara / Devon — if you have any examples of the metrics/slide you'd like to highlight, feel free to drop them back in reply (or send in a short doc). Deadline for speaker assets: June 20 so our production team has time to prep the clip.

I'll add the HubSpot contact and create a Deal note (HS:contact-452718 / DEAL-7892) so CS can track approvals.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Attachment stubs referenced: ProdScale_speaker_guidelines.pdf

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: sara.patel@fittergo.com, devon.k@fittergo.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.ai, jordan.blake@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invite: FitterGo customer advocate for 'Customer Voice' product roundtable

Hi Sara / Devon — Marissa here (Customer Marketing). Great to meet you both virtually.

I've attached a short draft agenda and a 1-page speaker brief (attached as fittergo_case_excerpt.docx). To recap:
- 15 min: FitterGo case study (architecture + rollout lessons)
- 10 min: Live audience Q&A
- 5 min: closing + CTA (how others can trial Redwood Dedicated)

Action items for FitterGo:
- Share 3 slides (logo + 2 slides of metrics/takeaways) by June 20
- Provide a 2–3 sentence speaker bio + headshot
- Confirm legal: permission to record + reuse short excerpt (we'll send specimen wording)

I've scheduled the prep call for Tue 6/16 14:00 PT (Zoom link included below) and attached the draft agenda. If the June 20 deadline is tight we can work around it but please let us know ASAP.

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/1234567890
Calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=prodscale-20260630

Thanks — looking forward to working with you.

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Customer Marketing | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
